rongmei.title: Ai ning e tingsaeng lunghpui ram

lines: 1. Ai ning e tingsaeng lunghpui ram,
Tuai dat makpui kachaek dandi namdaih tei;
Neihmik khang suang gaangai e tu e,
Ai houni e hei namdaih tei ‘kauhmei lungpui bam.
2. Meinun kauhnam nzuanpui chaeng,
Lai tatna tat maan pukhang ai rui ping e;
Pap phung bam khou rui pumtan maknga,
Kauh Kanaan ramgai gundaihmei hou lak khang rianra.
3. Poubaomei Bumaeng rui hamhna,
Thou rui guang tang ngam ni cho kandi khou rui;
Bumaeng maanlou pui bam kandi e,
Apoubaomei lummei guaita simei rui kham e.
4. Lummei guaimu tingkao ram khou,
Neihmik khang suang gaan gaina gaan bam puni,
Kandi khou rianra guai louduna,
Neihlanmei rui mun kum puangni tuai dat pulak khe.
5. Ai rui lungni kauh namdaih khou,
Tingsaenga zaengthaek puni hei kandi khou;
Pou’ rui damloumei Salem namdaih,
Aniu kapumma hei lungni rianramei maknga.
